patterns.note: The page is structured with distinct, full-width color-blocked sections that create strong visual breaks and guide the user through different content areas.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels.
A high-contrast, vibrant palette of energetic orange, deep black, bright white, and accent yellow is used to define content blocks and highlight interactive elements.

The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the central 'Minted with Manifold' text and graphic scroll slower than the orange background, creating a sense of depth as the page scrolls up.
A horizontal strip of partner logos is integrated directly below the hero, serving as a social proof element and a visual transition to the main content sections.

technique_notes: The hero section is built with layered elements where the background scrolls at a normal rate, but the foreground text and central graphic are animated to scroll at a slightly slower speed, producing a subtle parallax effect.
The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element, ensuring it remains visible and accessible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls, with elements potentially using CSS keyframes for subtle entrance animations, enhancing the visual flow without being overly dramatic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body size) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for buttons, cards, and section edges, contributing to a modern and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between full-width sections and within the hero, creating clear content separation, while card grids maintain a tighter rhythm.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, high-contrast color blocking, particularly the energetic orange and bright yellow, which are used to define large, full-width content areas. This, combined with the blocky, almost pixel-art-like graphics and a strong, modern sans-serif typography, creates a vibrant and contemporary feel that avoids generic templates.
